ORDINANCE SEPT 3, Po23

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols

and indications as shown on Map No. 3-I in the area bounded by

A line 125.40 feet North of and parallel to West Walton Street; the alley next East of and parallel
to North Mozart Street; a line 100.40 feet North of and parallel to West Walton Street; and North
Mozart Street,

to those of a RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 911 North Mozart Street
